# Targets Agency

> Targets (تارجت) is a digital marketing agency with a team from Palestine and Jordan. It works with small and medium businesses in Jordan, Palestine, the Gulf and with Arab business owners in the United States. Prices start from $200; the final price depends on the service and the size of the work.

Contact: WhatsApp +962 78 756 2587 · info@targetsagency.com · Meetings are online.

## Services
- [Ads management (Meta, TikTok, Google)](https://targetsagency.com/ads/): campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Google, measured from the first click to the sale, with a clear monthly report. English: https://targetsagency.com/en/ads/
- [Websites and online stores](https://targetsagency.com/web/): Arabic and English sites and stores, fast on mobile, connected to WhatsApp, ads and online payments. English: https://targetsagency.com/en/web/
- [Mobile apps](https://targetsagency.com/apps/): Android and iPhone apps in Arabic and English with payments, notifications and a dashboard. English: https://targetsagency.com/en/apps/
- [Automated message replies](https://targetsagency.com/automation/): instant replies on Messenger and Instagram (WhatsApp and TikTok can be connected), alerts when a customer is ready to buy, and a simple daily report. A 7-day free trial on your page is available. English: https://targetsagency.com/en/automation/
